empirical_question: Does previous positive male age-closeness proxy in Columbia versus negative in Mixmosa survive target & chooser fixed effects?

design.sample: all observed eligible directed speed dates with both actor and target ages, gender-specific
design.effects: chooser ID and candidate ID, iterative alternating projections
design.identification: signed age is perfectly collinear with chooser and candidate fixed effects, not reported
design.variance_check: abort if feature residual variance negligible or iteration fails
design.standard_errors: cluster by chooser; covariance from residualized X and residualized model residual
design.comparison: Columbia 2way FE age-only coefficients from original selected complete-case samples (N4071/sex), Mixmosa complete ages ~1888/sex; sample sizes differ
design.limits: no timestamp causal or homophily pure; post N47-52 adaptive selection, N53 a prospectively recorded robustness test but exploratory
